root_cause_supported: The shared authored normal-share (~25%) excites a slowly draining parallel plane. Dedicated piezo primarily observes normal force. Classic78 measured radiation projects the slowly decaying bridge moment more strongly than Original, revealing long high partials in the microphone. This explains why capture EQ alone changed level/contrast but did not satisfy the listener. It is a model-specific excitation/timbre mismatch, not a demonstrated factor-of-two unit bug or missing-damping defect unique to Classic.
